steps.content:
Six months had passed since the Ash Campaign. The Fraser Unity Gala came to an end, and the strife between DisCity and the Farland Alliance settled into a tentative pause. The perilous Rancor weapons have slowly been brought back under control.

A long while passed after that. Then Jasmine awoke.
But what followed brought no good news.

March 3, N.F. 116 
Special Containment Department of Banyan Fourth Hospital

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What do you mean, "put her back under"?!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I read the reports from EDGE. LINK was working. It was stabilizing her Mania disorder. The numbers were solid for a while. She was supposed to be getting better. Banyan told me she'd be back soon. Now, just a few days later, you're telling me something completely different?

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Please, Chief, try to stay calm. We've overhauled our treatment protocols, and we score very highly on all humanitarian reviews. I understand your concern for the Sinner, and I can assure you, no irregular procedures will be performed on her.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: The LINK session was a success. The patient, Jasmine, has regained consciousness. The problem... well, it's what happened after she woke up.
He gathers the thick sheaf of reports and moves to pass them across, only to stop halfway. He hesitates, then speaks:

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: ...Actually, this won't explain it well. You'd better come with me.

The deeper wards of Banyan Fourth Hospital carry a familiar chill. Its security and surveillance match the MBCC's suffocatingly rigorous standards. Here, too, the ones confined and studied are "patients" branded as dangerous lunatics.
As you press further in, the shackles stir with growing agitation. The madness of the Sinner tethered at the other end bleeds into you, driving your steps faster.
Yet before you arrive, a sharp, anguished scream cuts you down.
[Flash]

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Stay back! Get away from me!!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: My blades! Where are my blades?! Give them back! I want them back!!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhh!!

Then comes a sight that grips your heart. Through the thick one-way glass, you glimpse Jasmine: hair wild and matted, expression savage. Inside the cold grey concrete isolation chamber, she hunches low to the ground, back arched like a furious cheetah, roaring, her gaunt frame made starker by the pose.

Burly orderlies have trapped her in a corner. Though she is unarmed, they approach with syringes, sedatives, and medical kits in hand, only to be forced back several meters with every cautious half-step. It's clear this stalemate has worn on for quite some time.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Now you see the situation. Her mental state has deteriorated severely. She needs proper medication and psychiatric intervention. But as you can see, we haven't been able to get her to accept any form of treatment.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: If this continues, putting her back in stasis may be our only option before something far worse happens.
Before he can finish, an orderly is hurled across the room and slams hard into the one-way glass right in front of you. Several nurses scream, some breaking into sobs.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Sedative! Quick, the sedative!
You steady her trembling hand beneath yours and take a step forward.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Let me try. MBCC knows Sinners better. And Jasmine... we spoke before they put her under. Let me try.

You press forward, eyes trained on the far side of the isolation wall. Jasmine remains coiled in her attack stance, snarling at the orderly she knocked away, and now, she is looking right where you stand.
Through the one-way glass, you meet her bloodshot, frayed eyes at last.
She freezes.
Is it weariness? A glimpse of the orderlies' shifting faces? Did she just feel the shackles nearby amid the chaos? Or... did she somehow see you through that unseen wall?
Her rage falters. In its place, a trace of confusion surfaces.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Chief?

You move closer by slow degrees, allowing the shackles to grow warm, hoping that slender warmth can gentle her fury. The alarms quiet. The medical staff waver, then cautiously, at last, open the door.

The distance between you is small now, and the barrier is gone. Jasmine sees you. A daze sweeps over her, like waking violently from a nightmare, like she cannot trust her eyes. Then, at the soft sound of her name, it is her body that reacts first.
Reeling, stumbling, her steps feeble, yet she rushes toward you in quick, desperate strides.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Am I dreaming? Chief, is it really you? I—
Then she stops dead, just a few paces off. A shadow falls across her face.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...Why... you smell like... them...
You know at once what she means.
[Flash: Chief in Shattered Blade uniform]
Is it the stench of war? Lingering traces of the Shattered Blade? Months later, anything capable of triggering her should have faded entirely, and yet Jasmine caches it anyway.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You were with them, weren't you... You've become DisCity's blade too?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Then die with them!!!

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Chief, use your shackles!!

options: Unleash the shackles to protect yourself
Hold back and try not to aggravate Jasmine

choices.text: Unleash the shackles to protect yourself
Hold back and try not to aggravate Jasmine

steps.content: She lunges at you, and the shackles answer. Spikes rip through her body, stopping her cold, and the agony tips her into pure rage.

She screams, a raw and terrible sound, and her momentum carries her crashing into you, bearing you down to the floor. With her hands rendered useless, she resorts to her teeth, biting into the side of your neck, nearly chewing through the fabric to gouge out the flesh.

Everything you felt—grief, guilt—is devoured by primal fear. Your body bucks and shudders, helpless as any animal beneath a hunter's jaws, until the staff pour in and ram a heavy sedative into Jasmine's neck.
Jasmine collapses, pulled off you at last. Your blood glistens on her lips, stretched into a garish crimson grin.
One heartbeat more, and your throat would have been torn out. She could have done it.

You fight the instinct to subdue the "threat" with your shackles. She barrels into you, slamming you to the floor, her thin, skeletal fingers locking tight around your throat. The medical staff struggle to tear her away, but she holds fast, screaming, accusation and desperate plea twisted into one.
Then, just before the darkness takes you, a strong sedative sinks deep into her neck.
Jasmine slumps against your chest. Her eyes, bloodshot and wet, never close.
They hold you, full of hatred, swimming in tears.
[Cut to Black Screen]

[S-105 Psychiatric Evaluation Report]
LINK has restored S-105's psyche from the damage caused by Mania. The Fourth Hospital's evaluation confirmed her stability was sufficient for awakening. However, following the procedure, her personality and behavior have driven a sharp deterioration.
Persistent nightmares and prolonged refusal of sustenance have left her mental state dangerously unstable. Medical personnel cannot approach her safely, standard sedative protocols cannot be initiated, and there exists no means to "convince" an S-Class Sinner to accept treatment.

...Physicians believe she has activated a psychological defense mechanism, restructuring and fusing insurmountable trauma with past memories and cognition, resulting in a misalignment of emotional perception. She refuses to accept reality and is unable to trust the outside world. Mania has further amplified her aggression and real destructive potential...
The symptoms are excessively complex, clinical management prohibitively difficult, and no treatment plan can be formulated. S-105's mental state will only degrade further with time.

After thorough consideration, we strongly recommend that cryosleep be reinitiated for S-105.

Rancor suppression technology has been largely perfected. The Fourth Hospital can no longer use "research assistance" as grounds to protect her from actions by higher authorities. The assault on the MBCC Chief has attracted widespread attention. If she is not returned to containment, there is a high probability of a more severe security crisis in the future. Should that occur...

...the only outcome that may await her is humane termination.
For several nights after that day, you were haunted by vague, restless nightmares. They only began to fade once your application was granted and Jasmine's transfer to the MBCC was finalized.

You had worked tirelessly to make it possible, eliminating every conceivable diplomatic risk with the Outlands, rallying support from the FAC and relevant departments at Banyan Medical College, and laying down a web of classified protocols to ensure nothing would leak and no public disturbance would arise.

The Fourth Hospital claimed the rapid approval was simply because "someone in EDGE has your back," but the sincere help they lent you along the way was never a pretense. They were genuinely concerned, and you are thankful for that.
...You are almost certainly doing something foolish.
The light switches on. Jasmine does not lift her head. She does not scream, does not surge into another attack.

Her limbs are locked in custom anti-Mania restraints. After being shackled for so long, she has abandoned all resistance, only shrinking back another inch the moment you step inside, curling further into the narrow, cold metal chair.

The interrogation room is the cell that holds her, but she has sealed herself into something even smaller still, despising your approach. On the other side—behind monitors, outside the room—your subordinates are on full alert.

News of the Banyan Fourth Hospital incident had circulated everywhere. Nobody dares expose you to danger again. Between conducting a multi-officer interrogation and limiting her movements, you chose the latter, hoping it might disturb her less.

—Of course, such considerations mean nothing to her. In the shadow of her unkempt hair, Jasmine's glare locks onto you, dark and malevolent, tinged with a faint red gleam. This reunion is hard to breathe through.
After a long, drawn-out silence, you rise from your seat in the "safe zone" and step toward her, halting just before she can recoil. You indicate her wrists, chafed and inflamed beneath the cuffs.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If it's bothering you, I'll take them off.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It's just the two of us here. It's okay.
Seeing no resistance, you take another step closer and kneel down beside Jasmine, your hands moving to unfasten the tightest of her shackles.
She watches you for a long moment, then lowers her head and leans in, sniffing. At last, the ghost of a smile touches her lips.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You've washed... So many new scents on you now... Heh...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Trying to cover up that <color=#fb9259>stench</color>?
Your hands pause.

It seems she has indeed grown much calmer, her sharpness and cunning restored. She has enough composure left to test you, to provoke you, to hurt you, like a fox playing with a discovered trap, pressing just enough without ever going too far.
You don't answer. You keep working. Click. The first shackle comes free. She snatches her hand back at once, avoiding any chance of your touch.

You don't push. Instead, you ease back a little, lowering your gaze while still half-kneeling before her. You know she only has to glance down to see you. In this shift of height, you have become the one being scrutinized.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I did go to the battlefield. I've seen war now, Jasmine.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It kills. It destroys. It tramples everything that makes us human, enemy and ally alike. I threw myself into it to protect the people I love, and in just a few days, there was nothing left inside me but hate. Hating others and being hated back. Bleeding and making others bleed.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Finding something I truly believe... it wasn't easy. I tried my best. But there were still sacrifices I couldn't stop. Mistakes I can't take back. Shadows I'll carry for the rest of my life. You were right. Once you've been through something like that, nothing ever goes back to how it was.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But I don't want you trapped in the cruelest part of it.
You lift your head and meet her eyes.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not asking you to forgive me. I just want you to live. Whether it's the Mania or the war, there are treatments now that can ease your suffering, stop it from getting worse.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If you can't stand the touch of anyone from DisCity, then I'll find your friends, people you actually trust. We can send you back to the farlands. There will be kind people there who'll look after you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I have no right to wish you happiness. But this city has already put you through so much pain. Don't let us cage you again. Don't go back to that cold lab. Don't...
[Flashback: Jasmine being carried away]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Don't let the people you hate destroy you all over again. You fought so hard to survive that war. You shouldn't be heading toward an ending like that again.
Jasmine offers no response to any of your proposals. She only listens as you speak, and gradually, she stops recoiling. Her eyes rest on you, unguarded, without pretense.
She looks at you. Looks, and looks. And then, slowly, her hand rises, inching toward your cheek, and—

Her hand closes around your throat. You force down the shock, offering no sound, no struggle. Behind your back, your hand signals the surveillance camera to keep your people back. Stay calm, meet her eyes, don't let the conversation break, you keep telling yourself. You know, in this moment, you absolutely cannot look away.

A moment later, Jasmine smiles. She respects your courage, even if the rigid set of your muscles and the frantic pulse beneath her fingers tell her everything. She giggles, and at last her hand releases its brutal grip, softening into a gentle caress over the reddened skin of your throat.
After the long monologue you've carried alone, Jasmine finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... Why say all those things I can't understand? Chief... You're clearly just <color=#fb9259>afraid</color> of me.
Her fingers trail up, following the line of your jaw to your cheek, cool against your skin. They read every shift in your face, all while she wears a teasing smile.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Treatment? What's treatment? Strapping me down? Needles? Pills? Until I can't scream anymore, can't fight back? And if I'm too stupid to learn, just toss me back in the water to sleep and never let me wake?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hehe, I know how it works. That's exactly what those white coats think. I can see it in their eyes. They're scared of me, sick of me. But they have to come see me anyway.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh... You Disians are all the same. Just like those soldiers who came at me with their blades... You're no different.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: "Such a nuisance. She's an enemy. Why won't she just die already?"
She plays it up, her smile steeped in undisguised contempt and loathing.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The war is over. This isn't a battlefield. There are no blades here meant to kill. I'm not your enemy. I want you to live.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You're not my enemy? How strange... You're certainly no family of mine!
She draws nearer, her hands mapping your face in fine, careful detail. Smiling, she reads your features the way one might hold up a head torn loose on the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Not an enemy, not family... Then what are you to me? Why can't you just let me go?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Your pain tears me apart too. I can't let go.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't talk like you know me!
She pushes you away with sudden force.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Where I came from, where I've walked, everything I've seen, heard, breathed in... how much could you possibly know? What right do you have to decide how I should live?
Then her expression shifts again. She leans in close to your ear and breathes, sly and teasing.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Or... why don't you grant my wish?
You know exactly what she means by "wish."
[One-Second Flashback: The Great Expo Closing Ceremony, where Jasmine, manic and blood-soaked, flanked by FAC in black]
And in turn, she reads your answer in the tight, strained silence.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You won't, will you? I knew it from the start. So why even bother?
She arches back, extending her limbs in a languid stretch.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Sigh... I'm sorry, Chief. Truth is, I do understand. You've always belonged to their side. Looking at me hurts you. Getting close to me scares you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: If I weren't so awful, picking up Sibilla's tricks, using my pain to make you feel sorry for me, to make you care, you'd never have to waste so much of yourself on me.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: It's only because you're so kind that you can't bear to see me like this. Sigh... Let yourself off the hook. Let me go too. You don't have to force yourself to love me.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Your love is too big, Chief. You love too many things. You can't let go of me, but you can't let go of my enemies either... So just take it all back.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I don't need that kind of love.
She tries again to push you off, but this time, it doesn't work.
You catch Jasmine's thin hand, holding it fast, refusing to let go. Her expression flickers from surprise, then disgust, then fury. She struggles, but still you do not release her.
You know you are doing something foolish.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Whether this is out of kindness, duty, guilt, or some other need to help her... don't set your hopes too high, Chief.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: There are wounds in this world that can't be healed. Some lives won't let you in. Jasmine's past is too heavy; taking her on will be far harder than you imagine. To prevent more serious consequences from unfolding, I will always advise you to cut your losses while you still can.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Otherwise, sooner or later, you will regret this.
His face is grave as he speaks. You realize he isn't talking only about Jasmine anymore. To a doctor's eye, you, too, are slipping into the role of a patient.
Still, your mind is made up. You keep your grip firm around Jasmine's hand.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I know you think it's worthless. Hate me if you want, but I won't let you go.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You owe me a few things too.

options: Remember the promise we made before the "celebration"?

choices.text: Remember the promise we made before the "celebration"?

steps.content: [Flashback] Lap Pillow CG

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Take me to the celebration, and I'll come back to you after it's over. Just as promised.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Once the closing ceremony ends... I'll follow you anywhere.
[Back to Interrogation Room]

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Thanks to MBCC, you made it to the celebration. The closing ceremony's over. Time to keep your word now.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...You sly thing... sneaky fox... How dare you...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: That was all a lie! Fraser's people taught me to do that! They told me you could get me to the closing ceremony, said you were a soft-hearted fool. That's the only reason I picked you, got close to you, played sweet for you... None of that counts! I was lying!
She shoves you, hits you, her nails carving bloody lines across your skin. But you cling on, refusing to let go.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If a promise can be kept, it was never a lie. I believe you meant every word, Jasmine.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Last time, the war got in the way. You said the most beautiful promises are always the easiest to break in wartime. But the war's over now. Your blades are under control. There's no better time than now, Jasmine.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: One at a time. I remember all of them.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You said in DisCity, the only meat you ever ate was sandworms, and they tasted awful. You wanted to try the amazing food I mentioned.
She stiffens. But you keep going, your eyes locked on hers, each word deliberate and steady.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...You said if DisCity had celebrations or fireworks, you'd like to see them too.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: And rain, snow... summer, autumn, winter. If there were more good people around me, you'd like to meet them too. You wanted to make more friends.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I remember every single thing you said. Your future doesn't belong in a cage, Jasmine. Promises have to be kept; that's where you're meant to go. See it all first, then I'll set you free.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...I want you to be truly free. I'll do whatever it takes.
She looks at you, her lips parting slightly. Words rise and fall away. There are several times she almost speaks, only to press her mouth shut again. After a long moment, she slowly lowers her gaze.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Why do you remember all that...? It was all foolishness, lies... things that can never come true...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You should've just forgotten...

options: ...I won't forget. Because you haven't either.

steps.content: Her long hair falls forward, veiling her face from view. But slowly, the rigid tension in Jasmine's spine eases, and her body, as if in a daze, leans just slightly toward you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: ...I know. I know you mean well, Chief. Thank you...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I don't believe that my hometown is gone anymore. Even after the movie ends, Goldionville must still be around. Someday, I will go back to find it.
She looks up, her eyes holding a genuine warmth you haven't seen in so long.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I'll do as you say. I'll stay by your side. Just like we promised.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Jasmine...
The weight pressing on your heart lightens, and without thinking, you reach for her hand.
—Only to find she has already taken yours. Her touch is startlingly cold.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But before that... I have one more wish.

The dancer rises, her waist bending like a reed as she takes your hand and sweetly reels you in. Her eyes have turned, now slick with cunning, and her voice climbs tenderly around you, drawing you into her hold.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: There are some people I'd love to meet. The ones who visit my dreams, over and over... <color=#fb9259>The Shattered Blade</color>. That's their name, right?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I know they're friends of yours. And I know you can find them. Won't you take me to see them, Chief?
Every muscle in your body locks tight.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: General Augustus departed WhiteSands with the main Shattered Blade force in mid-September. Their return date remains uncertain. Nirvana Port is currently under the supervision of that adjutant with the iron mask. The good news is, he didn't turn down your request.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Shattered Blade has shared their latest Rancor suppression technology with MBCC. That's exactly how we were able to safely separate Jasmine from her dangerous blades. It's been highly effective in controlling the Mania exposure she's experiencing.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's rather surprising, honestly... That was their core proprietary technology. They turned down the Ring Research Institute more than once. Yet now they've agreed to share it with us... Chief, how did you manage to convince them?
[Interrogation Room]
Jasmine leans against your shoulder, her hand trailing downward to rest lightly over your heart. She narrows her eyes.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I know what worries you. I promise I won't hurt them. They're your friends, after all. And you're such a good person, Chief... Your friends must be wonderful too.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Didn't you say you wanted me to step out into the world? Meet more good people? Let them be the ones, then.
Beat by beat, she listens to your heartbeat with narrowed eyes, a familiar smile slowly creeping across her lips.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: That Outland woman... I remember her. The Great Expo, the closing ceremony. Augustus infiltrated the FAC command convoy, and not even their on-site security caught on. But that Outlander did, precisely.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Hell of a fixation. No chance in hell of winning, but she just kept coming, like a rabid dog that won't let go. Even had the nerve to turn our own blades on us... Heh. Suits Rancor perfectly, I'll give her that. Corrupted to this point, she'd be better off not waking up at all. Pitiful.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: So go on, then. Try and fix her, Chief. Fix her. Keep her on a short leash. And don't let her try anything that stupid again.
[Interrogation Room]

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Take me to them, please? Jasmine will be so good. I won't do a single bad thing. I trust them, just like I trust you.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Chief... I have only this one wish. Please, I'm begging you.
She blinks, doe-eyed and innocent, her smile honeyed as melting frosting, overflowing with dependence and trust in you. It is a smile you know intimately.

The eve of the Great Expo—that was when she last smiled at you like this. Even steeped in hatred and pain, she can still put on this smile. Discordant, untimely, it remains carved upon her face like an indelible epitaph.
You know she is lying to you again.
But these broken hands, once released, will fall straight into nothingness. You can only grip them tighter.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The Shattered Blade is out on a mission. I can't reach them right now. Once they return, I'll take you to meet them.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Until then, you'll accept treatment. You'll stay with me and keep our promise. Okay?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Really?! Chief, you're the absolute best! It's a promise now. You can't take it back!
You have put on a false mask of your own.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: We'll both keep our word.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Thank you... thank you, Chief...
She nestles her head lightly against your chest, a happy, satisfied smile gracing her face as she takes in the heavy beat of your heart.
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Jasmine's past is too heavy; taking her on will be far harder than you imagine... Sooner or later, you will regret this.
[Black Screen]
You're doing something foolish, that much is certain. But... you just can't let go.
